sh: knee-high flames, heat shimmer, rising embers
tongue of flame, licking forward edge
f: Points at the problem. Sets it on fire.

sh: wide wall of tall flames, thick embers
f: Not a campfire. Definitely not a campfire.

sh: towering ring of fire, swirling smoke crown
f: The floor is lava, and also the walls.

sh: glowing coal fleck, faint smoke trail
drifting grey flakes, dim orange specks
f: Fire's leftovers. Gets in your eyes.

sh: wobbling heat haze dome, orange tint
low flat flame sweep, black scorch trail
f: Leaves a mark. A crispy mark.
Look at the pretty light. Ow.

sh: low glowing coals, curls of thin smoke

f: Things got heated. Then very heated.

sh: spark streak that blooms into flame
ragged flame wave, uneven leaping tongues

f: Hotter than the orange kind. Shows off.
Fire that read too much poetry.
Warm, but in a haunted way.
Follow the pretty light. Do not.
Borrowed from a star. Not returning it.

sh: golden sun circle on the ground, rays up

f: Cool to the touch. Still burns.

sh: roaring cone of flame, glowing fang shapes
glowing orange flow, dark crust plates
f: Not solid. Not liquid. Not friendly.

sh: slick ice sheet, jagged crystal edges
soft cold breeze with drifting flakes
f: Relax. No, literally, you are frozen.

sh: long tapering ice spike, drip tip
feathery white crystals on every surface

f: Frozen since forever. Not thawing for you.
You will not see it coming. Whee.

sh: low rolling white fog, frosty cubes
dome of frost, everything glazed white
rolling blue surge with white foam lip

f: Fancy word for water. Still wet.
One drop. The start of something.
Water that is late for something.
Goes one way. Takes you with it.
Round and round and round and down.

sh: massive sea vortex, crashing white rim
f: A whirlpool with a bad attitude.
Looks calm. Drags you out to sea.

sh: ground vent firing tall water column
wide slow wall of rising water
f: Comes in. Goes out. Takes your sandcastle.
Float away in a fragile little ball.

sh: glowing droplets with soft gold sparkle
f: Splash of goodness. Undead hate it.

sh: murky salty wave with crystal flecks

f: When fire and ice stop arguing.

sh: jagged white-gold zigzag from the sky
visible sound ring, purple-grey shock rim
f: Loud enough to rattle your teeth.

sh: crackling blue arcs across the ground

f: Hair goes up. Dignity goes down.
Fourth state of matter. First state of ouch.

sh: floating crackling sphere, arcs flicking out
f: A lightning bolt that chose to roll.

sh: instant ring of compressed air, sparks
f: The sky claps its hands. Ow.

sh: wave of electric arcs racing outward
f: All the power. All at once.

sh: wavering bright arc between two points
raised earth slab, grass tufts on top

f: Classic. Never goes out of style.

sh: huge rounded rock, cracks and moss

f: Skips on water. Bonks on heads.
Dirt in the eyes. Classic move.

sh: mound of dark earth with sprouts
f: Good for gardens. Bad for intruders.
Your boots are staying here now.

sh: cluster of tall glowing hex prisms
f: Shiny wall. Very hard to argue with.
Not moving. Not now, not ever.

sh: glowing orange rock flow, black crust
molten orange pool, black crust cracks
f: The floor is lava. Not a game anymore.
Slugs fear it. Ghosts too, maybe.

sh: stone spike erupting from the floor
dripping stone spike falling from above
dull rock shell cracking to purple crystals

f: Stay still for a million years.

sh: streaking pale air lines and leaves
sharp burst of swirling air lines
soft drifting air ribbons with petals

f: You breathe it. Now dodge it.
Wind that took the stairs too fast.

sh: spinning column of air and leaves
f: Spin to win. Mostly to spin.

sh: upward rushing air column, leaves rising
downward slam of air, flattened grass
long fast air river with streaks
f: A highway in the sky. No speed limit.
A friendly little breeze. Very fast.
A baby tornado with no manners.
The wind is on your side.

sh: warm golden ray from the sky

f: Light from very far away. Very late.

sh: soft warm halo around the caster
instant white burst with lens streaks
thick golden ray with dust motes
f: A cat's favourite spot. Now a weapon.
Not day, not night, very moody.
You will find it in your shoes for years.
A hint of shiny. A whisper of hope.

sh: inky smoky dart with violet edge
f: Follows you around. Now it bites.

sh: thick black fog dome, faint violet sparks
jagged black rip with violet glow rim
bottomless black pit with purple mist
f: Do not stare into it. It stares back.

sh: starry dark-blue dome falling over area
dark wave rolling across the sky

f: The darkest part of the shadow.
Cannot see. Do not want to see.
Most of the universe. Very shy.
Pushes the universe apart. And you.

sh: swirling sickly green fog, skull wisps
glowing green puddle, bubbling barrel shapes
f: The glow is not a good sign.

sh: neon droplets that hiss on contact

f: Slow, gross and coming for you.

sh: withering grey ground with green veins
drifting murky cloud with fly specks
pulsing green glow field, ticking motes
f: Gives you a glow. Not the good kind.
Nobody wants this. Least of all you.
Smells like gym socks and regret.
Tough as nails. Made of nails.
Everyone stops to pick it up.
Liquid metal that refuses to sit still.
So shiny you can see your fear.
Magic fuel. Do not drink from the tank.

sh: starry blue orb with pointy-hat sparkles

f: The most basic magic. Still magic.

sh: glowing carved symbol on the ground
f: Step on it. See what happens.
Cosmic vibes, directly to the face.

sh: soft glowing wisp with tiny trail
f: Everyone has one. Do not lose it.
What goes up, comes down. Hard.
Sound, but you can see it.
Hits the exact note that breaks things.
Objects at rest stay at rest.
Hard to stop. Harder to dodge.
Energy of movement. Now moving at you.

sh: mini star core, swirling plasma rings

f: Smoke and mirrors, minus the mirrors.
Everyone looks like a chimney sweep.
The pulse of a true hero.
